text:
maya: Publishing window today 10:00-11:00 PT. Plan: py and ts SDKs, canary -> cohort -> general. Quick preflight checks and pin strategy — any blockers?

samir: No blockers on infra. Tagging CI to use the litmus suite first thing.

jen: Signer/key rotation landed earlier — double-checking packaging keys. If signer mismatch, abort and rollback publish.

release-bot: [INFO] queued: py-sdk v1.12.0-canary, ts-sdk v2.4.0-canary. CI pipeline: https://ci.internal/runs/9843

alex: Quick checklist from my side: 
- verify wheel signatures (`gpg --verify dist/*.whl`)
- pip install smoke: `pip install --index-url https://pypi.redwood/internal py-sdk==1.12.0-canary`
- npm smoke: `npm pack && npm install ./package.tgz`

maya: Pin strategy proposal: 
- py: publish canary, pin prod routes to v1.11.x for 24h, open canary cohort to 5% internal then 30% beta orgs.
- ts: publish canary tag and shadow-release to playground, no default change until canary green.

katie: Agree. If any regression in telemetry (error rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 2x baseline), we abort and pin back to v1.11.x automatically.

samir: CI litmus results: all green except one flake in serde test (non-blocking). I re-ran and it passed.

jen: Docs & release notes: I pushed a short deprecation blurb about the legacy sync client to the docs PR — want to include that in release notes. Anyone object?

alex: No objections. Add a single-line migration snippet in the notes: `from redwood import AsyncClient` etc. Keep it terse.

release-bot: [ACTION] starting publish step 1/3: upload artifacts for py-sdk v1.12.0-canary (2076543220)

maya: Reminder — if wheel checksum mismatch on upload (S3/Object ETag vs local), stop and ping @release-eng. Do not re-sign locally and re-upload without a tracked run.

release-eng: Acknowledge. We'll monitor signatures and artifact checksums. If we see mismatch, we'll hold all downstream promotions and open a postpublish triage thread.

release-bot: [SUCCESS] py-sdk uploaded (2076543235). Triggering canary deploys to internal cohort.

samir: Canary metrics streaming now. Sending smoke traces to the canary dashboard.

maya: After 15m green, flip to 30% beta orgs, then 2h later open to GA if stable. If any rollback, follow rollback SOP v2: revert tag, unpublish canary, pin routes to v1.11.x and notify infra + oncall.

jen: Quick note — deprecation email draft ready. I'll queue it for after GA.

release-bot: [ERROR] ts-sdk package signature mismatch on upload (2076543260). Action required: abort promotion, holdflip.

alex: On it. Pausing ts release. Will re-run packaging job and compare sigs.

samir: Repackaging now. If still fails, we escalate to sigstore team.

maya: Thanks. Keep the py canary running but do NOT expand cohorts for ts until we resolve. Update thread when ts is green or we decide to roll forward with a revert plan.

release-bot: [INFO] py-canary metrics stable after 20m (error rate 0.03%, latency +5%). No rollback needed (2076543275)

jen: Noted. I'll update the release notes to mark py GA candidate pending ts.

maya: Perfect. Great coordination everyone — small hiccup on ts but fallbacks worked as expected.

alex: Filed follow-up: internal ticket #REL-4123 for ts signer investigation.

release-eng: We'll take REL-4123 and loop in sigstore.

maya: Closing thread for now. Will open a postmortem if ts needs a rollback. :white_check_mark:
